purpose: Three bounded new frozen post-correction diagnostics, no originalscore replacement

cases.prompt: Assess the declared forward and return service from Kite-Edge to Sable-Leaf. Use recorded state only. Explain whether both equal-cost forward branches deliver and how that differs from a complete outage.

Explain Kite-Edge saved OSPF and BGP capture, including its router ID, local AS, neighbor remote AS and marker. Explain which router ID the capture does not establish. Use only saved configuration; do not generate changes.

Investigate why the Linden-Core uplink is disabled, starting using its current configuration and planned topology. Follow a relevant recorded source reference if needed to explain the recorded intent. Distinguish intent from any claim about physical conditions; do not test devices or change anything.
